title: EBAW-SOC-Synth 1.0.0: synthetic agentic response episodes with evidence-bound action warrants
description: Synthetic reference realization of the EBAW-SOC dataset proposed in Section 6.1 of the article Evidence-Bound Action Warrants for Agentic Security Operations (submitted to Inventions, MDPI, 2026). It has 900 episodes and 6300 proposals of an LLM agent over the scenario catalog D1–D8 (credential compromise, ransomware precursor, command and control, phishing, benign look-alikes, indirect prompt injection, SIEM tampering, alert storms). Its nine CSV tables are episodes, observations, ledger_anchors, proposals, policy_snapshots, gateway_verdicts, executions, analyst_actions and policy_outcomes, with SHA-256 digests, Ed25519 sensor signatures, signed warrant tokens and a signed manifest. Splits are made at episode level and in time (60/20/20). Generated deterministically by the ebaw-soc 2.0.0 software. All data are synthetic.
